description: Declarative edits: describe the whole edit in one project.json and render it in one command.

argv.description: raw CLI arguments (non-canonical compatibility path; when present every other key is ignored)

audit_log.description: append the audit records of this run (a refused plan, a lock taken over, ...) to FILE as JSON lines; default for a refused plan: <plan>.audit.jsonl next to it. A record that cannot be written is a warning, never a failure

brand.description: brand.json the template's captions, graphics and overlays use

cache.description: reuse the artifacts of identical stages from a previous run. Opt-in: there is no default directory. The ffmpeg version and the skill version are part of every key, so a cache never crosses either.

cues.description: cue file for the template's captions (caption.py --text format)

dry_run.description: print the ffmpeg commands that would run, run nothing

export_timeline.description: export an editor timeline (.fcpxml, .edl or .otio) without rendering media. The result lists the project elements omitted by the format.

fast.description: preview quality: x264 preset veryfast (overrides --preset) for quick iterations

fit.description: override how the template reaches its aspect

from_stage.description: start at this stage, taking every earlier one from --cache; refuses if one of them is not there

hw.description: run every stage's encode on Apple VideoToolbox, the final delivery export included (Apple Silicon; falls back to the CPU, reported, where it cannot apply). Without it, $FFMPEG_SKILL_HW=1 still puts the intermediate stages on the GPU and leaves the delivery export on the CPU

image.description: still image behind the visualisation (audiogram template); a local file, nothing is fetched

init.description: write a starter project file and exit

intermediate_preset.description: x264/x265 preset of the stages before an encoding export (default superfast: the export re-encodes them, and its own preset sets the delivered quality); medium = the stages' own default. Not used without an export stage, with --stop-after before it, with --fast, or for a copy export

json_brief.description: like --json but trimmed: status, output, dry_run, verified, a compact summary of the output probe, this tool's own keys, and the command count instead of the command lines (failures print the full failure document, unchanged)

keep.description: keep intermediates (default: kept only when --work is given)

list_templates.description: print the templates with their frames, limits and safe zones, and exit

no_hw.description: every stage on the CPU encoders, whatever $FFMPEG_SKILL_HW says

output.description: output file (default: next to the input, <input>_<template>.mp4, or .m4a for an audio-only destination); for a list of templates or 'all' its directory is where the pack is written

overwrite.description: allow replacing an existing output (refused without it)

plan.description: write the dry run as a plan (inputs fingerprinted, commands, expected output, verify steps) that render.py FILE executes later; implies --dry-run

project.description: (positional 1) project.json, or a plan.json written by <tool> --plan

srt.description: SRT file for the template's captions instead of --cues

template.description: render INPUT with a shipped template: audiogram, facebook, linkedin, podcast, reels, shorts, tiktok, x, youtube, youtube-shorts, a comma-separated list, or 'all' (the social pack)

timeout.description: kill an ffmpeg run past this many seconds, kind=timeout (default 1800; 0 = no limit)

title.description: title text for the template's opening card / lower third

write_project.description: write the filled project.json for editing and stop (no render)

name: render
